mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions intensify, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate margins face headwinds from input cost pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers central bank hawkish policy expectations that increase real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In expansionary economic conditions (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% q/q), a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% and HOUST decline > 0.5%).
